title: Token Encoding for Semantic Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2604.12931v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In generative semantic communication, semantic tokens guide receiver-side generative models to synthesize high-dimensional content. In challenging network environments, however, frequent token erasure distorts the conveyed semantics beyond what receiver-side recovery can restore. In this paper, we propose a token encoding framework (TokCode) for robust semantic recovery, achieving erasure resilience by restructuring redundancy in the semantic domain. TokCode uses a lightweight adapter to recast a general-purpose large language model (LLM) at the transmitter into a token encoder, exploiting the LLM's pretrained semantic prior to avoid introducing a dedicated deep model. To optimize the adapter efficiently and make it applicable across diverse channels, we develop a channel-quality-aware distillation approach for token encoder training~(CADET). translated_title: 面向语义恢复的令牌编码
translated_abstract: 在生成式语义通信中，语义令牌引导接收端的生成模型合成高维内容。然而，在具有挑战性的网络环境中，频繁的令牌丢失会使所传递的语义失真，超出接收端恢复能力所能修复的范围。本文提出了一种面向鲁棒语义恢复的令牌编码框架，通过在语义域中重构冗余来实现抗擦除能力。TokCode使用一个轻量级适配器将发射端的通用大语言模型（LLM）改造为令牌编码器，利用LLM预训练获得的语义先验，从而避免引入专用的深度模型。为了高效优化该适配器并使其能够适用于多种不同信道，我们开发了一种信道质量感知的蒸馏方法用于令牌编码器训练（CADET）。CADET使用可微分的句子级语义代理对T5基础模型进行调优……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TokCode框架，利用轻量级适配器将大语言模型改造为令牌编码器，并通过信道质量感知的蒸馏方法CADET进行训练，通过在语义域中重构冗余实现抗令牌丢失的鲁棒语义恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TokCode, a token encoding framework that repurposes an LLM into a token encoder via a lightweight adapter trained with a channel-quality-aware distillation method (CADET), achieving robust semantic recovery against token erasure by restructuring redundancy in the semantic domain.
